WITH sentiment_trans_trader AS (
  SELECT 
    sf.transref,
    sf.anlycount,
    t.tradekind
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  WHERE sf.anlycount IS NOT NULL
),
trans_trader_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    transref,
    tradekind,
    AVG(anlycount) as pair_avg_anlycount
  FROM sentiment_trans_trader
  GROUP BY transref, tradekind
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(pair_avg_anlycount) as overall_mean_val
  FROM trans_trader_avg
),
above_mean_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    tta.transref,
    tta.tradekind,
    tta.pair_avg_anlycount,
    tta.pair_avg_anlycount - om.overall_mean_val as margin
  FROM trans_trader_avg tta
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
  WHERE tta.pair_avg_anlycount > om.overall_mean_val
),
trader_type_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    tradekind,
    AVG(pair_avg_anlycount) as avg_analyst_count,
    AVG(margin) as avg_margin
  FROM above_mean_pairs
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
mean_of_analyst_counts AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_analyst_count) as mean_analyst_across_types
  FROM trader_type_stats
)
SELECT 
  tts.tradekind,
  tts.avg_analyst_count,
  tts.avg_margin,
  tts.avg_analyst_count / moac.mean_analyst_across_types as relative_to_mean
FROM trader_type_stats tts
CROSS JOIN mean_of_analyst_counts moac
ORDER BY tts.tradekind;
